description: JavaScript plugin for image rotation using jQuery, supporting various browsers including IE, with functions for rotating images, getting rotation angle, and stopping rotation.

classes.name: Wilq32.PhotoEffect
classes.description: Main class handling the image rotation effect, including setup, animation, and browser-specific handling.

methods.name: _setupParameters
methods.description: Initializes rotation parameters such as angle, animateTo, easing, duration, callback, and center.

methods.name: _handleRotation
methods.description: Handles the rotation process, setting up parameters and starting animation.

methods.name: _Loader
methods.description: Loads the image, handling different browser capabilities, and prepares the canvas or VML for rotation.

methods.name: _animate
methods.description: Performs the animation step, updating the rotation angle.

methods.name: _rotate
methods.description: Applies the rotation transformation to the image or canvas, with browser-specific implementations.
